reason: When I book dinner for the family, kalbi at $38.95 a plate plus the automatic 20% tip for five or more adds up quickly. I can get naengmyeon and BBQ for the group cheaper on Keeaumoku St, where we already go.
objection: Nineteen bucks for cold noodles and close to forty for kalbi, before tax and the 20% gratuity, is a lot for a group dinner when I don't know this place is any better than my usual spots.
would_change_my_mind: A family set or BBQ combo for 4 to 6 people at a fixed price that comes out cheaper per head than ordering à la carte.
